headline: Eve Air Mobility Agrees to Sell Up to 12 eVTOL Aircraft to FlyBIS
summary: Eve Air Mobility signed an agreement with FlyBIS Aviation Limited for the sale of up to 12 electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft, including two firm orders and ten purchase rights.
why: Commercial commitments for electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft indicate progress in the advanced air mobility sector, impacting future revenue streams for developers.
